translations.web: When he was in distress, he begged Yahweh his God, and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers.
translations.bsb: And in his distress, Manasseh sought the favor of the LORD his God and earnestly humbled himself before the God of his fathers.
translations.kjv: And when he was in affliction, he besought the LORD his God, and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers,
